headline: Barret Zoph, the Thinking Machines co-founder ousted before joining OpenAI, is now at Google
context: Zoph, who co-founded Thinking Machines Lab alongside Mira Murati and also served as the startup's CTO, led a brief stint at OpenAI and is now at Google.
